newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS says New Toyo a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - DBS says New Toyo a buy.

text.p: DBS Investment Research on Friday recommended a buy on New Toyo International Holdings Ltd due to increased demand for the group's paper products.

DBS said that while share prices of debutante New Toyo, a maker of paper and packaging materials, were unlikely to perform well during its "when-issued" trading period due to poor sentiment now, they were expected to firm.
"We expect New Toyo shares to move gradually towards its fair value of 92 cents over a six month horizon," DBS said in its research report.
Its shares briefly hit a high of Singapore $0.85 at open before tailing off at midday to trade below the initial public offer (IPO) of S$0.80 on poor market sentiment.
At 0830 GMT, the shares were around S$0.80, with over 6.7 million shares traded.
DBS said growth in output by tobacco companies in Asia and new applications for laminated products would fuel demand for the group's paper products and enlarge its customer base.
It added that New Toyo would also benefit from the full year contribution from its new China plants.
"Given the good prospects of the group, we recommend a buy," DBS said.
